mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification_event SET event_status = '1', processing_key = #{processingKey}, processing_started_at = now(6), update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_program = #{updateProgram} WHERE event_status = '0' AND processing_key IS NULL ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, notification_event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: WITH latest_per_task AS ( SELECT e.notification_event_id , e.household_id , e.notification_type , e.actor_user_id , e.target_user_id , e.entity_id , e.aggregation_date , e.occurred_at , row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY e.entity_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC , e.notification_event_id DESC ) AS rn FROM t_notification_event e WHERE e.event_status = '1' AND e.processing_key = #{processingKey} ) , picked AS (SELECT * FROM latest_per_task WHERE rn = 1) , latest_in_group AS ( SELECT p.* , row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.target_user_id , p.notification_type , p.aggregation_date , p.actor_user_id ORDER BY p.occurred_at DESC , p.notification_event_id DESC ) AS grp_rn FROM picked p ) SELECT max(CASE WHEN g.grp_rn = 1 THEN g.household_id END) AS householdid , g.notification_type AS notificationtype , g.actor_user_id AS actoruserid , g.target_user_id AS targetuserid , max(g.occurred_at) AS latestoccurredat , count(*) AS taskcount , g.aggregation_date AS aggregationdate , max( CASE WHEN g.grp_rn = 1 THEN g.entity_id END ) AS latesthouseworktaskid FROM latest_in_group g GROUP BY g.target_user_id , g.notification_type , g.aggregation_date , g.actor_user_id ORDER BY latestoccurredat DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification_event SET event_status = '2', processed_at = now(6), update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_program = #{updateProgram} WHERE event_status = '1' AND processing_key = #{processingKey}
